description:
Why this issue exists: server.rs route_method() dispatches JMAP method names via a large match arm on &str. The set of method strings in the match is not compile-checked against the dispatcher map built in build_jmap_dispatcher(). A method can be listed in one place but not the other and the mismatch is invisible at compile time. When a new method is added, the developer must remember to update both locations.

What needs to be done: Introduce a typed enum for JMAP method names (MethodName) and use it in both the dispatcher map and the route_method match. Alternatively, collapse route_method into the dispatcher map entirely so there is only one registration point. This eliminates the maintenance hazard of two out-of-sync lists.
title: route_method: single 400-arm match on method string; not compile-checked against handler set
